reasons: The cited text meets every preferred parameter: successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewal terms, a 30-day Customer non-renewal notice window, a Vendor reminder at least 60 days before renewal (with the opt-out deadline extended 30 days if the reminder is late), and an uplift cap at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

The single failing deterministic check ('number not found') is a false negative caused by the numerals being spelled out in words ('thirty days'', 'twelve-month', 'three percent'); the rationale correctly identifies and restates them numerically.
The rationale correctly distinguishes § 8.1's three-year fixed initial term from an automatic multi-year renewal, so the walk-away trigger is not implicated.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline was proposed and no counterparty comment was generated; the paragraphs are returned unchanged, which is the expected output.
